items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: No, sir, I never met them at all, see.

ctx.x: This charity show in Philadelphia at the Hippodrome Theater there at that time. They had one in Philadelphia, and they had one over here on Third Avenue in New York City, you see. And -- we were like aging, you see. Mr. Robey was supposed to come back like in -- and he would -- we were supposed to stay with him like until we became of age like, you see.

But that didn't happen because Nat Nazarra came along, see. He was looking for a Little Buck'n Bubbles at that time. He already had the original Buck'n Bubbles. They were great stars. They were the biggest colored stars we had at that time besides like, see, because Bert Williams, he was the first one. That was Williams and Walker. They were very famous.
Had you met Williams and Walker up to this point?
